title: Sehrgarning yangi kuchlari: Uch shar, Teshuvchi shar, Muz qalqoni

steps.eval: const score = g.score; const all = new Map(); for (let k = 0; k < 80 && all.size < 11; k++) { g.stage = 'fight'; g.enemies = []; g.update(0.016); for (const u of g.choices) all.set(u.id, u); } g.choices = ["triple", "pierce", "thorns"].map((id) => all.get(id)).filter(Boolean); g.choiceIndex = 0; g.upgradeLock = 0; g.score = score;

const score = g.score; const all = new Map(); for (let k = 0; k < 80 && all.size < 11; k++) { g.stage = 'fight'; g.enemies = []; g.update(0.016); for (const u of g.choices) all.set(u.id, u); } g.choices = ["heart", "reach", "dash2"].map((id) => all.get(id)).filter(Boolean); g.choiceIndex = 0; g.upgradeLock = 0; g.score = score;

title: Teshuvchi shar — bir dushmandan o'tib, keyingisiga tegadi

steps.eval: const p = g.player; const [a, b] = g.enemies; a.x = p.x + 45; b.x = p.x + 95; a.y = b.y = p.y; a.aiTimer = b.aiTimer = 99; p.pierce = 1; p.fx = 1; p.fy = 0; p.cooldown = 0; g.input.pressAttack(); for (let i = 0; i < 90 && a.hp === a.maxHp; i++) g.update(0.016); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) g.update(0.016); g.update = () => {};
const p = g.player; p.frost = true; p.flash = 0.4; g.onPlayerHurt(); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) g.update(0.016); g.update = () => {};
